segments.text:
V. 30.
He that is not with me is againſt me—For there are no Neuters in this War. Every one muſt be either with Chriſt or againſt Him; either a loyal Subject or a Rebel▪ And there are none upon Earth, who neither promote nor obſtruct his Kingdom. For he that does not gather Souls to GOD ſcatters them from Him.
